reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

common.actual_use: The member value is an input, output, model or evidence object of the exact native formal activity already bound in analysis_r12. Its predicate is the consequential requirement on that value, with the exact current claim, comparator, semantic near-miss and residual retained. These are guarded interface contributions, not required adoption or already checked programs.
common.F027_forward: An actual valid typing theorem can establish the stated representation/safety condition at this value boundary. If a richer type really encodes the stated predicate and its logic/evaluation/unsafe conditions are met, it can establish that predicate too. Ordinary well-formedness does not imply the displayed semantic requirement.
common.F027_reverse: The native value and consequential predicate identify which typing guarantee is useful and whether ordinary representation safety is already sufficient for this particular interface. They expose the additional functional relation when a wider claim is made; the native requirement alone does not prove type soundness.
common.F046_forward: The rejected universal type-safety-implies-functionality does not remove useful representation evidence. The exact native semantic near-miss can retain the ordinary shape while changing the required predicate. Credit a specification-rich type only for the requirement actually encoded, and keep empirical/application correspondence separate.
common.F046_reverse: The native receiving function supplies the precise missing or already-encoded predicate against which the actual type theorem must be interpreted. This is a semantic adequacy criterion, not a proof that the language or program satisfies it.
common.F028_forward: A dependent/refinement interface can express this concrete value predicate, for example a result v:T paired with evidence of P(v), or a function from admitted inputs to that result. If the actual sound typing/proof judgment succeeds, that particular bounded obligation is discharged. The predicate is not credited merely because it appears in a type declaration.
common.F028_reverse: The native value, admitted input/domain and required relation select the actual dependent/refinement predicate. They reject a convenient weaker proxy or a type carrying an assumed rather than established world fact. They do not supply termination, evaluation soundness or a proof term.
common.F035_forward: A proof/certificate for this concrete predicate can be checked against this exact value/model/artifact, providing the named evidence input without trusting the producer to be correct on every output. A checked weaker predicate or different value does not meet the native obligation.
common.F035_reverse: The native consumer predicate, actual value identity and admitted assumptions determine what the proof checker must accept as the relevant evidence. They constrain the formula and binding; they do not establish the checker/parser/logic or independence of shared inputs.
common.guards: Use the actual supported type/proof language, operational/evaluation semantics, trusted kernel/checker/parser, axioms and unsafe/foreign boundaries. A runtime schema check, Python annotation or hash is not a language soundness proof. Probabilities supplied as model parameters do not become calibrated observations; normative authority is not created by an authorization-shaped token.
common.partial_scope: A representation, finite functional or formula guarantee remains a material partial input even when timing, physical correspondence, support, currentness or the whole mission claim is open. An ordinary type may be the complete needed helper contract. This does not turn every typed datum into assurance for a different function.
common.quantitative_scope: A certificate can check the stated arithmetic or model implication. It cannot make iid/HPP, renewal, stress-life mapping, ascertainment, population weighting or causal intervention premises true by accepting them as axioms. Numerical error bounds and supported transcendental functions must match the actual checker.
common.control: Already executed NX08 gives same-shaped correct and wrong migrated histories; retained C14 gives a sorted/sum-correct output that is not the required permutation. Their stronger semantic predicates distinguish the alternatives. These are concrete controls on functional extension, not refutations of the ordinary representation fact.
common.cost: Compare ordinary types plus a direct semantic check, a short reviewed derivation, an unchanged reusable certificate and a richer type. Count annotation, checking, proof-search, evolution and integration work. No requirement for a new certificate on each unchanged use and no uniform cost/benefit claim.
common.execution: Own exposed analytical interface definitions over previously inspected native meanings, code and cases. No new typechecker, proof assistant, certificate checker or program experiment is executed. No result from a hypothetical checker is reported.

native_members.actual_value_boundary: Fault/timing/storage model record and protocol theorem inputs.
native_members.consequential_typed_or_certified_predica: The admitted transition relation and theorem premises include precisely the faults and bounds credited by the protocol claim.

native_members.actual_value_boundary: Integrated lock/resource-acceptance state and stale-holder cases.
native_members.consequential_typed_or_certified_predica: The actual protocol prevents the relevant harmful accepted mutation under its bounds; token representation alone is not enforcement.

native_members.consequential_typed_or_certified_predica: The calculation respects the actual joint-law constraints and function; marginal probabilities do not encode independence.

native_members.consequential_typed_or_certified_predica: The modeled boundary prevents the specified propagation before the protected function fails within its actual capacity/domain.
